reading_source: Manually reviewed each supplied sentence: kanji readings and contextual topic は → わ and object を → お. Lexical は preserved; 予定通り → よていどおり, 悪気 → わるぎ, 一回 → いっかい. Added 30 unique sentences with manually checked readings: 一人ひとり, 寂しいさびしい, 気を遣うきおつかう, 失ううしなう, 選択肢せんたくし, 結局けっきょく, 思った通りおもったとおり, 判断はんだん. Contextual particles checked individually; lexical 話はな and 判断はん preserved.
notes: Sentence recordings at 1×. No audible listening or pitch-accent verification claimed. Reviewed all 40 sentences for prosodic grouping after user reported a pause before the topic particle in 自分では. Added speech-only commas at complete phrase or clause boundaries to 13 recordings and explicit guidance keeping particles with preceding phrases. Display text and lookup keys retained. Existing recordings not auditioned; audible pause timing is not verified.
